name: Vietnam Open
stakes: This week is a crucial opportunity for India's rising badminton stars to gain vital ranking points and experience, while seasoned players look to maintain momentum on the international circuit.
summary:
India's contingent at the Vietnam Open Super 100 has showcased a mix of promising performances and tough exits. Young talent Tanvi Sharma has continued her impressive run, battling past compatriot Malvika Bansod in a quarterfinal clash to secure a spot in the semifinals. Joining her in the Women's Singles last four is the third seed, Isharani Baruah, who also navigated her quarterfinal match with a straight-sets victory, and Rakshitha, who has made a surprise run to the semifinals.

On the Men's Singles front, HS Prannoy, a seasoned campaigner, has also progressed deep into the tournament, showcasing his experience. While Malvika Bansod's journey ended in an all-Indian quarterfinal, the overall picture for India is one of strong representation in the crucial penultimate round of this Super 100 event.
